_claim: The paper's §5.2 parameters FOR EVERYTHING THE CODE EXPOSES: 50 generations, t = 10**4. This is NOT a full paper-faithful reproduction - see _deviations.
_deviations: T_b: the paper states 0.01; optimizer.py line 138 hardcodes T = 0.05 and exposes no parameter. This run uses 0.05. Reaching 0.01 would require editing upstream.
Selection: Algorithm 1 replaces the population with the best of the new candidates; evo() sorts parents and children together (elitist). Unchanged here.
Mutation: the paper sets M = 1; evo() mutates with probability 99/100. Unchanged here.
De-duplication against an explored set and an early exit on all-0.5 are additions in evo() not present in Algorithm 1. Unchanged here.
population_init 'previous' is the shipped cross-round warm start; the paper restarts fresh each round. Set to 'fresh' to follow the paper, and record which you used.
num_samples is passed explicitly; main.findGoodInputDifferences passes nothing, so this is a deviation from the released code's own default.
